_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Dialogue-Jodi.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

2_1.japanese: 夫の ケントは 兵士で、 海外で 働いているの。だから 今 ここにいないのよ。#$b#遠征を 無事に 終えて 帰ってくるって 信じてる！#$e#何か 入用かしら？
2_1.english: My husband Kent is a soldier, working overseas. That's why he isn't here now. I believe he'll finish his expedition safely and come back! Do you need something?

AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea.japanese: まあ…そんなに貴重なものをもらっていいの？本当にありがとう！
AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea.english: Oh my... is it okay for me to receive something so precious? Thank you so much!

Fri.japanese: $d Joja#Jojaマートの 食品は 家族にとって 健康とは 言えないけど、 あの 値段なら 他のところで 買う気も 起きなくなるわ！|ピエールの店の 食品は Jojaマートで 買えたものよりも ずっと 新鮮で ヘルシーね。でも、Jojaマートの あの 安さが 恋しいわ。
Fri.english: [if Joja] JojaMart's food can't be called healthy for a family, but at those prices you don't even feel like buying anywhere else! | [otherwise] Pierre's store's food is much fresher and healthier than what I could buy at JojaMart. But I miss JojaMart's cheapness.

segments.gloss: stops arising / you don't feel like it

GreenRain.japanese: あなたは大丈夫？こんなことは初めてだわ…$s#$e#夫がここにいてくれたらよかったのだけど。彼なら、どうすればいいか適切に判断できるはずだもの。$s
GreenRain.english: Are you okay? This is the first time something like this has happened... I wish my husband were here. He'd surely be able to judge properly what to do.

segments.gloss: it would have been good, but...

GreenRain_2.japanese: ヴィンセントったら、雨の中を外で遊ぶために早起きしたのよ。この雨に本当に害がないことを願ってるわ！
GreenRain_2.english: Vincent got up early to play outside in the rain. I hope this rain really is harmless!

Introduction.japanese: あっ！想像とは 違う タイプね… まぁ、 いいかな！私はジョディ。#$e#ここは 小さくて 静かな 町だから、 新しい 人が 来るのが 楽しみ なのよ！牧場主が 来たことで 何かが 変わるんじゃ ないかしらね。
Introduction.english: Oh! You're a different type than I imagined... well, that's fine! I'm Jodi. This is a small, quiet town, so I look forward to new people coming! I wonder if something will change with a farmer having come.

Mon.japanese: 家庭を 維持するのって 難しいけど… 誰かが やらなくちゃ ならないのよね。#$e#そうでしょう？
Mon.english: Maintaining a household is hard... but somebody has to do it. Isn't that right?

Mon2.japanese: $d kent#昨日、夫が無事に帰ったことへの感謝のためにヨバ神の祭壇に行って来たわ。|昨日、夫が無事に帰って来るようにヨバ神の祭壇でお祈りして来たわ。#$e#前向きでいようとがんばってるけど、時々つらくなるのよね。$s
Mon2.english: [if Kent is back] Yesterday I went to Yoba's altar to give thanks that my husband came home safe. | [otherwise] Yesterday I prayed at Yoba's altar for my husband to come home safe. I'm trying hard to stay positive, but sometimes it gets hard.

segments.gloss: yesterday (after dialogue condition: Kent is home)

Mon6.japanese: 家族を 持てて 幸せだわ… 若かった頃の自由さが 恋しくなることは あるけどね…$s
Mon6.english: I'm happy to have a family... though there are times I miss the freedom of when I was young...

Resort.japanese: 息を飲むような景色ね！見渡す限りの深い青…
Resort.english: A breathtaking view! Deep blue as far as you can see...

segments.gloss: to swallow (息を飲む: take one's breath away)

Resort_Bar.japanese: ガスの活躍、みんなはそれが大好きなの。
Resort_Bar.english: Gus in action — everyone loves that.

segments.gloss: being in action / doing his thing

Resort_Leaving.japanese: 今夜はシーフードにしようかしら。$h

Sat.japanese: こんにちは。#$e#何か 用かしら？

Sat4.japanese: あの 古い牧場を 良くしてくれている みたいで うれしいわ。#$e#全て 順調に なったら、 コミュニティに 大きく 貢献 できそうね！$h#$e#あなたは、 沢山の仕事を こなすことに なるけど。#$e#じゃあね。
Sat4.english: I'm happy that you seem to be improving that old farm. Once everything is going well, it looks like you'll contribute greatly to the community! You'll end up handling a lot of work, though. See you.

segments.gloss: looks like you'll be able to (make)

Sun.japanese: #$c .5#今日の 家事は これぐらいにするわ。$h#$e#今日は これで お休みよ。$h#$e#これ以上 家に 閉じこもってたら、 気が変になっちゃう！#$e#足が太くなるのも イヤだし。
Sun.english: I'll stop the housework at this much for today. I'm taking the rest of today off. If I stay shut up in the house any longer, I'll go crazy! And I don't want my legs getting thick either.

segments.gloss: I'll leave it at this much

Sun8.japanese: 自分以外の誰かに尽くす必要のない、完全に自由だった夢を見てたわ。#$b#…でも目を覚ますと、一日中家事に 付きっ切りっていう現実が待っているのよね…$s#$e#でも家族を持つことに後悔はないわ、@...。サムそしてビンセントは私にとってすべてだもの！
Sun8.english: I was dreaming that I was completely free, with no need to devote myself to anyone besides me. ...But when I wake up, the reality of being stuck with housework all day awaits me... But I have no regrets about having a family, @... Sam and Vincent are everything to me!

segments.gloss: being tied up with, as they say

Thu.japanese: あなた、牧場主なんでしょ？　面白いわね。#$e#牧場主に 会ったことが なかったの。#$e#野菜の 育て方を いつか 教えてくれるかしら。$h
Thu.english: You're a farmer, right? How interesting. I'd never met a farmer. I wonder if you'll teach me how to grow vegetables someday.

segments.gloss: I wonder if you'll teach me

Thu6.japanese: 時が過ぎるのって あっという間ね。はぁ…#$e#サムが オムツを つけていた 頃のことも 覚えてるわ。あの頃の サムは 本当に かわいかった。$s#$e#これ、あの子には 内緒よ。$h#$e#私と お話するのが 本当に 好きなのね。
Thu6.english: Time passes in no time, doesn't it. Sigh... I still remember when Sam was wearing diapers. Sam back then was really cute. Keep this a secret from him. You really like chatting with me, don't you.

Tue.japanese: 運動は 健康を 保つのに 重要よ。私は 運動の時間を ちゃんと 取るように しているわ。#$e#親だから、 自身に 費やせる時間が あんまりないけどね。だから 時間は 有効に 使いたいの。
Tue.english: Exercise is important for keeping healthy. I make sure to properly take time for exercise. Being a parent, I don't have much time I can spend on myself, though. So I want to use my time effectively.

Wed.japanese: なんて言ったの？もう %time なの？ああ！#$e#まだやることが 沢山 あるのに！$s
Wed.english: What did you say? It's already %time? Oh! I still have lots to do!

Wed4.japanese: もっと 外に 出たいけど、 やることが あまりにも 多すぎるわ。#$e#手が 硬くならないよう、 ゴム手袋を つけるように したわ。#$e#年を取るにつれて、 健康を保つために しなきゃ いけないことが 増えるのよね。$s#$e#またね！
Wed4.english: I want to go outside more, but there's way too much to do. I've started wearing rubber gloves so my hands don't get rough. As you get older, the things you have to do to keep healthy increase, don't they. See you!

segments.gloss: I want to go out, but
so as not to become hard

cc_Bus.japanese: バスが修理されたんですって。パムはきっと喜んでるわ…#$b#仕事がなくなってからお酒の量が増えたって聞いたから… これがいいきっかけになると思うの。
cc_Bus.english: I heard the bus was repaired. I'm sure Pam is happy... I heard she's been drinking more since she lost her job... so I think this will be a good turning point.

segments.text: 修理されたんですって。

dating_Sam_memory_oneday.japanese: あなたとサムのことを聞いたの。あの子があなたに迷惑をかけないか心配だわ！$h
dating_Sam_memory_oneday.english: I heard about you and Sam. I'm worried that kid might cause you trouble!

eventSeen_101.japanese: かわいそうなクリント… 彼はエミリーのことが好きらしいの。でもエミリーは彼を友達としか思ってないって聞いたわ…
eventSeen_101.english: Poor Clint... apparently he likes Emily. But I heard Emily thinks of him only as a friend...

eventSeen_3102768.japanese: ペニーは優しい子よ。ヴィンセントの面倒をよく見てくれるし、ヴィンセントはペニーが大好きなの。
eventSeen_3102768.english: Penny is a kind girl. She looks after Vincent well, and Vincent loves Penny.

eventSeen_3910975.japanese: （ささやき）シェーンのことは聞いた？とても心配だわ…大丈夫だといいのだけど。$s
eventSeen_3910975.english: (whispering) Did you hear about Shane? I'm so worried... I hope he's alright.

segments.gloss: it would be good, but (I hope)

eventSeen_58.japanese: 毎週、女性を集めてエアロビクス教室をやっているの…#$b#最近新しい人が入ったんだけど、彼ったら自分のことは絶対に秘密にしてくれって言うのよ！
eventSeen_58.english: Every week I gather the women and do an aerobics class... Recently a new person joined, but he told us to absolutely keep who he is a secret!

eventSeen_94.japanese: あの魚を持ってきてくれてありがとう！あんなに素晴らしい食材は久しぶりだったわ。
eventSeen_94.english: Thanks for bringing that fish! It had been a long time since we had such a wonderful ingredient.

segments.gloss: was the first in a long time

fall_Mon6.japanese: 私は自分がどんなに恵まれているかを自覚しなくちゃいけないわ。私たちはここで幸せに暮らしている。世界には十分な食べ物が手に入らない人もいるのよ。$s
fall_Mon6.english: I have to be aware of how blessed I am. We live happily here. In the world there are people who can't get enough food.

segments.text: 自覚しなくちゃいけないわ。

fall_Sun.japanese: 私、 キャロラインとは 仲がいいのよ。彼女には 何でも 話せるの。
fall_Sun.english: Me, I'm on good terms with Caroline. I can talk to her about anything.

fall_Sun2.japanese: あなたも 親に なったら、 昔の 生活を 捨てることに なるわよ。#$e#絶対捨てなきゃ いけないわけじゃ ないけど… 気をつけないと そうなるわ。
fall_Sun2.english: When you become a parent too, you'll end up throwing away your old life. It's not that you absolutely have to throw it away... but if you're not careful, that's how it'll go.

fall_Thu.japanese: たぶん、 子ども達を 甘やかしすぎたのかも。彼らに 家事を させてなかったから。#$e#子ども達には、 若い間に 色々と 楽しんでほしいと 思ってるのよ。まあ、 サムは 十分 大人に なったけどね。#$b#怠け者に なってなかったら いいけど…そうは 行かないわよね。$s#$e#親になるのって 難しいわ。
fall_Thu.english: Maybe I spoiled the kids too much. Because I didn't make them do housework. I want the kids to enjoy lots of things while they're young. Well, Sam has become plenty grown up, though. I hope he hasn't become lazy... but it won't go that way, will it. Being a parent is hard.

segments.text: 甘やかしすぎたのかも。

fall_Thu_inlaw_Sam.japanese: サムは農場でただブラブラしているだけなのか、それとも貢献しているのか？
fall_Thu_inlaw_Sam.english: Is Sam just loafing around on the farm, or is he contributing?

married_Sam.japanese: あなたとサムがしあわせそうで私もうれしいわ！本当にお似合いの夫婦ね！#$e#サムの部屋からうるさいギターの音が聞こえなくなるのをさびしく思う日が来るなんて思わなかったわ…$s
married_Sam.english: I'm happy too that you and Sam seem happy! You really are a well-suited couple! I never thought the day would come when I'd miss not hearing the noisy guitar from Sam's room...

pamHouseUpgrade.japanese: まあ…パムのことは聞いたわ…どうして彼女はこんなに親切にしてもらえるのかしら。$s#$e#…私もそんな大金を持ってみたいわ…$s
pamHouseUpgrade.english: Oh my... I heard about Pam... I wonder why she gets treated so kindly. ...I'd like to have that kind of money too...

segments.text: してもらえるのかしら。$s#$e#

pamHouseUpgradeAnonymous.japanese: パムの新しい家を見た？はぁ…私もそんな大金を持ってみたいわ…せめてキッチンだけはリフォームしたいの…$s
pamHouseUpgradeAnonymous.english: Did you see Pam's new house? Sigh... I'd like to have that kind of money too... I want to remodel at least the kitchen...

reject_864.japanese: これは？ケントの戦友の1人みたいね。彼に見せた方が良いんじゃないかしら？
reject_864.english: This is? It looks like one of Kent's war buddies. Wouldn't it be better to show it to him?

segments.text: 良いんじゃないかしら？
segments.gloss: wouldn't it be good, I wonder?

summer_Mon.japanese: 夏は良い季節だけど、 仕事も増えるのよね。#$e#家のことは もちろん、 お庭も ちゃんと 手入れ しなきゃ！
summer_Mon.english: Summer is a good season, but the work increases too. Not just the house, of course — I have to properly take care of the garden too!

summer_Sun.japanese: 今日は いったいどんな 夕食を 作ろうかしら？#$e#はぁ…
summer_Sun.english: What on earth kind of dinner should I make today? Sigh...

summer_Thu.japanese: 家事って、 いつまでたっても 終わらないから ストレスが 溜まるのよね。#$e#床を 掃除しても、 次の日には もう汚れてる。
summer_Thu.english: Housework never ends no matter how long you go, so the stress builds up. Even if I clean the floor, by the next day it's already dirty.

segments.gloss: no matter how much time passes

summer_Tue.japanese: こんにちは。#$e#何か 用かしら？今は 少し 忙しいの。
summer_Tue.english: Hello. Do you need something? I'm a little busy now.

summer_Tue_inlaw_Sam.japanese: 私の小さなサミーは、古い農場でどうしてますか？$h
summer_Tue_inlaw_Sam.english: How is my little Sammy doing on the old farm?

winter_Fri.japanese: たまにでも いいから 休暇を 取れたら うれしいなぁ…$s
winter_Fri.english: Even just once in a while is fine — I'd be happy if I could take a vacation...

winter_Mon.japanese: 子どもの頃、 雪で 遊ぶのが 好きだったわ。母親になって 良かったことと いえば、 また 雪で 楽しめるように なったことかしら。$h
winter_Mon.english: When I was a child, I liked playing in the snow. If I talk about good things about becoming a mother, maybe it's that I can enjoy the snow again.

winter_Sun.japanese: 私が お金持ち だったら、 まず メイドと シェフを 雇うわ。#$e#ええ、 そういうのって 本当に ステキよね！$h
winter_Sun.english: If I were rich, first I'd hire a maid and a chef. Yes, that kind of thing is really lovely, isn't it!

winter_Thu.japanese: サムの 音楽が とても うるさいの。お隣さんの 迷惑に ならなきゃ いいけど。
winter_Thu.english: Sam's music is really loud. I hope it doesn't bother the neighbors.

winter_Thu8.japanese: ケントが兵士になるから、私達は急いで結婚したのよ…若さと自由をあまり味わえなかったし、振り返るにはもう遅すぎる。$s#$e#それをあなたに言うなんて信じられない。$4
winter_Thu8.english: Because Kent was becoming a soldier, we hurried to get married... I couldn't taste much youth and freedom, and it's already too late to look back. I can't believe I'm saying that to you.

winter_Thu_inlaw_Sam.japanese: サムとの 暮らしは どう？あの子が 家を 出て以来、 料理と 掃除が 少し楽になったのよ。
winter_Thu_inlaw_Sam.english: How's life with Sam? Since that kid left home, cooking and cleaning have gotten a little easier.

segments.reading: sukoshi raku ni natta no yo

winter_Tue.japanese: ねぇ。みんなが あなたの 牧場について 聞いてくるの、 飽きてこないかしら？#$e#私なら ウンザリしそう。
winter_Tue.english: Hey. Don't you get tired of everyone asking about your farm? If it were me, I'd probably get fed up.

segments.gloss: don't you get tired of, I wonder?

winter_Tue6.japanese: はぁ… 時々、 家族の世話を しなくてもいい　独り身の 生活をする 夢を 見るの…それって 恐ろしい 夢かしら。$s#$e#誰にも 言わないでよ。$4
winter_Tue6.english: Sigh... Sometimes I dream of living single, not needing to look after a family... I wonder if that's a terrible dream. Don't tell anyone.

winter_Wed2.japanese: 何をするのが 好きかって？うーん…いい 質問ね。#$e#寝るのが 好きよ。$s
winter_Wed2.english: What do I like to do? Hmm... good question. I like sleeping.

winter_Wed4_2.japanese: ケントが 帰ってきてから しばらく たったけど、 まだ 落ち着かない みたいね。$s
winter_Wed4_2.english: It's been a while since Kent came back, but he still doesn't seem settled.
